topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Hey, I heard about the surprise party getting cancelled and you know what? I think you just dodged a bullet. Honestly, sometimes these things don’t go as planned and it’s totally okay. Maybe this is a sign to do something even more special, just a smaller, cozier get-together or maybe a spontaneous adventure instead! We could turn this around and make it awesome without the stress. What do you think? Let’s chat and figure out the perfect plan B, because you deserve to feel amazing and have a day that’s all about you. I’m here to help, just say the word!
